templates.name: Tenerix NAS by Prometheus
templates.description: Tenerix NAS (RN426, Alpine) health from tenerix-metrics via Prometheus /federate. Generated by boot/rn426/md-system/metrics/zabbix/build-template.py.

items.name: Prometheus federate: tenerix metrics
items.description: All tenerix_* samples of the NAS from Prometheus; every other item depends on it.

triggers.name: No metrics from the NAS for {$TENERIX.NODATA}
triggers.description: tenerix-metrics stopped, the NAS is down, or Prometheus/Collector does not receive it.

triggers.name: High load average on the NAS
Low available memory on the NAS

items.name: CPU idle
items.description: Idle CPU seconds per second (4 = all four cores idle).

items.name: CPU time, all modes
items.description: CPU seconds per second over all modes = number of cores.

items.name: CPU utilization
items.description: Same name as in the Linux templates, so dashboard "Top hosts" widgets list the NAS.

trigger_prototypes.expression: last(/Tenerix NAS by Prometheus/tenerix.md.active[{#MD}])<last(/Tenerix NAS by Prometheus/tenerix.md.disks[{#MD}])
trigger_prototypes.name: RAID {#MD}: fewer disks in sync than expected
Encrypted volume on {#CRYPTDEV} is locked (needs arch01.py mount)
File system {#MOUNT}: {#ETYPE} errors on {#MEMBER}
trigger_prototypes.description: Btrfs device stats / ext4 errors_count is non-zero; check dmesg and run a scrub.

item_prototypes.name: Disk {#DISK} ({#SERIAL}): helium level
item_prototypes.description: Normalized SMART 22 (100 = full); vendor failure threshold 25.

trigger_prototypes.name: Disk {#DISK} ({#SERIAL}) helium level near failure threshold
Fan {#FAN} is stopped or too slow

macros.description: Prometheus base URL (set on the host).
host_name label of the NAS in Prometheus.
Alert when no metrics arrive for this long.
